headline.funnel_interpretation: Insufficient studies to perform formal publication bias testing.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 2 studies yielded an overall effect size of 0.53 (95% CI: 0.29–0.98), suggesting that antioxidants is associated with a lower risk of uterine cancer. These findings were supported by moderate between-study heterogeneity (I² = 41.49%), suggesting some variability in the results across studies.
